summary: auth login with no flags opens the installed Chrome/Chromium headed in a CLI-owned profile (<data dir>/login-browser), waits for the user to sign in, reads only __Host-instacart_sid plus the optional Same-Day companions over CDP (browser target only: Target.getTargets, Storage.getCookies, Browser.close), saves them with the session-cookie expiry and closes the browser; --chrome and --cookies-file stay as fallbacks. Actionable errors: expired/missing session says run auth login, a 429/rate-limit page on a costco.com host aborts with wait 15-30 minutes, keychain/keyring denials from --chrome suggest the browser login or the cURL import. auth status and doctor report the live session verdict (valid member / guest / expired), account type and expiry; auth status exits 4 when the probe shows the session expired.
reason: The user could not sign the CLI in: Chrome Safe Storage rejected his keychain password, the box Chrome profile only held a guest session, and failures gave no next step.
rules_check: cli-printing-press skills/printing-press/references/browser-sniff-capture.md forbids shipping a resident browser / browser sidecar transport for normal commands; a login-only browser that exits after capture matches the sanctioned press-auth companion (docs/solutions/logic-errors/auth-login-chrome-broken-2026-05.md, chromedp-controlled Chrome with a separate user-data-dir) and the dominos-pp-cli auth login precedent (library/food-and-dining/dominos/internal/cli/auth_login.go). Normal commands remain plain HTTP.
markers: Costco is rate-limiting sign-in (HTTP 429 from signin.costco.com)
validated_outcome: go build/vet green; go test ./internal/cli green, including headless Chrome against a local TLS fake sign-in page (guest cookie, /signin, callback that sets the member cookie): only __Host-instacart_sid and ahoy_visit are captured (an unrelated cookie is not), expiry is recorded, the browser's DevTools port closes after capture, a 429 sign-in page aborts with the wait message, a guest-only session times out with a Sign in via Costco.com hint, and auth login end to end saves the session and auth status reports the expiry. auth status / doctor tests use local stubs (member, guest, HTTP 401); no test reaches the real site.
